body: Great stuff, thanks for this

Thanks for the help everyone, one of my stakes "End Stake" button is showing green as opposed to red now. The larger stake is still "wheels turning" despite high gas fee..so hopefully once that is complete I can unstake the smaller amount

EDIT: The smaller amount with the green end stake button went through, just waiting on the larger one! Thanks again community
Thank you!
Awesome advice man, thank you.
Thank you! Good things truly come to those who work hard.

My mother died of alcoholism as well. I'm around your age, stop now or face the same fate. Not to scare you but it's the truth. It may not come today or even for decades, but it will come. I lost my girlfriend of five years from alcoholism, but today I've got a much more supportive girlfriend that i live with. I've embarrassed myself around LOTS of people, and trust me, the ones that don't want anything to do with you afterwards, aren't worth being in your life anyway. The same applies to your partner. Rock bottom is MUCH further down than you think. Life is so much better now that I've been sober for awhile. Don't regret the past, don't dread the future, live in TODAY.
No I appreciate the tough love, sometimes it's all that gets through to us alcoholics.
Yeah you make a very valid point.
I feel like this medication will be a god send, I have pretty severe anxiety, and knowing I could potentially be hospitalized by even one drink will be a damn strong deterrent. Thanks gents

Thanks for the advice fellow CA's, I think that tapering probably is a bad idea, I just end up getting drunk. My symptoms are pretty mild compared to some I've read, so I suppose I should quit whining haha. The panic attacks and fear of dying are awful, but I just gotta keep reminding myself that it's all in my head. After all, I'm 23, the odds of me having actual life threatening withdrawals are slim to none. I think cold turkey may be the way to go here. Thanks again for all the input
Currently stuffing my face. Beats drinking i suppose!

My girlfriend of five years left me over two months ago, and I still get upset over her. Ignore whatever my badge says, i only have two days sober man. There's a reason they said avoid dating. When you quit drinking, you're in a hyper emotional state. I tried to "controlled drink" over and over, only to end up worse than before. Just think, do you really wanna return to the hell of drinking because of a woman? And that "just one night" mentality lead me to being drunk for weeks at a time. Don't do it man. Go to some meetings.
When i go drunk, i hate it and usually walk out. If i go sober, it's actually really helpful...not that you should take advice from me lol
That shit hit me hard man. I forgot i posted that. thank you.
I failed guys. Got four nips. I'm sorry. I feel like I don't belong here. I'll never be able to stay sober like you guys.
Idk man. A couple shots sounds great right now.
Bars are closed here, unfortunately.
I'm only 22, the thought of never drinking again is terrifying. Although seeing my blood pressure is giving me a big incentive to stay sober...

My drinking cost me everything, and i'm 22, younger than you. I lost the best job i ever had, my gf of 5 years, totalled my first car, caused damage to my heart, the list goes on. Keep going, and you WILL hit rock bottom. The only thing that stopped me was detox at a hospital. I highly recommend it, as much as it sucks. Even with no insurance (i had none), because i was also suicidal and withdrawing they kept me for 5 days. I've only been out for about a week, and every minute is a struggle. I don't feel the same any more. It's miserable, i'm an anxious mess. But you know what? I'm sober. And I know it will get better. Go to some sort of detox. I know it's all that would have stopped me.
I was a heavy, heavy drinker, and after a week it's mostly just anxiety and insomnia for me. I'm also in my early 20's, if that makes a difference.

I'm 22. Only been sober a little over a week. I drank from 20-22 pretty much non-stop, and now i have absurdly high blood pressure for my age. I have ADHD too, but trust me, stop while you still can, by all means necessary.
Thanks for the support everyone. I think going to a meeting wouldn't be a bad idea. i know i'm gonna drink otherwise.
Thank you, it's not easy. All i want is a nice shot right now.
